CVE-2026-0858.title: Versions of the package net.sourceforge.plantuml:plantuml before  ...
CVE-2026-0858.description: Versions of the package net.sourceforge.plantuml:plantuml before 1.2026.0 are vulnerable to Stored XSS due to insufficient sanitization of interactive attributes in GraphViz diagrams. As a result, a crafted PlantUML diagram can inject malicious JavaScript into generated SVG output, leading to arbitrary script execution in the context of applications that render the SVG.

CVE-2026-137955.title: PlantUML through 1.2026.10, including PlantUML Server, contains a ...
CVE-2026-137955.description: PlantUML through 1.2026.10, including PlantUML Server, contains a local file read vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass SANDBOX and INTERNET security profiles via Graphviz node attributes. Attackers can submit @startdot diagrams with image or shapefile attributes to render local image files into PNG output and probe whether arbitrary local paths exist.
